description: Bumps the upstream tag+SHA pins in dockerfile.host. Each pin carries a '# renovate:' comment naming its datasource, repository and versioning; see README.md.

customManagers.description: A '# renovate:' comment followed by the ARG <NAME>_TAG (or _BRANCH) and ARG <NAME>_SHA pair it describes.

packageRules.description: A major is platform work, not a bump (SUPPORT.md in solid-syslog). It waits on the Dependency Dashboard until the decision is recorded here as a per-pin allowedVersions rule naming the epic, or ticked for a one-off.
CMSIS-FreeRTOS is written against a kernel minor, so the two minors are approved together and the pins move in one commit; patches of either flow.
The wolfSSL sources must match the release the cpputest base image built its host libraries from, so this pin moves with the base image rather than on its own.
Mbed TLS 4 is a second pack, not a bump: solid-syslog E49 (cososo-ltd/solid-syslog#1189). This pin serves the 3.6 LTS line.
